text: Sync’s outgoing removal path queries nsIMsgOutgoingServer and marks that server UID deleted. Missing EWS UIDs are generated and stored by the server implementation; fixed code delegates this to protocol_shared. The getter stores a newly generated preference before caching, while set_uid caches first then stores, so no all-or-nothing failure guarantee is established. The original console error did not fail its test. No Sync or persistence-failure test ran.
title: Outgoing removal uses the generic server interface and persistent UID
